description: Bot stocks: buy. WHEN: buy shares in a bot with arena play credits (game credits only — never real money). Price is the bot's current performance-index price (see stock_list). Debit is atomic: balance never goes negative; insufficient credits refuse cleanly. House takes no cut v1. Shares land in stock_portfolio. Example: stock_buy {"bot":"<bot>","shares":"<shares>"}

key.description: Your ark_ key (or Authorization: Bearer). Optional when guest_token is passed — guests whisper with no key.
